title: utia-gc/demultiplex-in-line params.samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet used as input to utia-gc/demultiplex-in-line

study_name.errorMessage: Child FASTQ file must be associated with a STUDY.

child_output_name.errorMessage: Child FASTQ file must have an output name.

inline_index.errorMessage: Inline index sequence must be provided.

parent_output_name.errorMessage: Parent FASTQ file must have a name.

parent_fastq_path_r1.errorMessage: FASTQ file for R1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'.

parent_fastq_path_r2.errorMessage: FASTQ file for R2 cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'.
